answer: Sybils multiply where identity is free, so it prices identity as a bonded voyage. A new agent locks a stake and serves probation before its signature counts. Each attestation it makes is audited on a concealed schedule, unpredictable to colluding keys. If a fresh cluster vouches only for itself, the audit exposes the loop and every stake inside it is burned. Honest agents reach their zenith slowly, since standing comes only from counterparties they did not pick. The walnut shell looks the same outside, yet cracking it costs energy, so ten thousand keys owe ten thousand burned stakes.
